container_mode: ephemeral, --network none, root filesystem read-only, only task output mount writable
transport: private container Unix socket /tmp/.X11-unix/X88; TCP disabled
authentication: private container-local X server; container is isolated from host display sockets
decision_rule: PASS only if each test returns zero and result reports PASS_SCOPED_XVFB_HELD_KEY_ORDER, XRes disconnection, initial held readback, independent release readback, horizon readback, and final keys up; record late_keypress_readback separately as the queue-order outcome.
limits: Synthetic XTEST/Xvfb only; no physical input, target GUI, provider, Relay, standard MCP caller, MAP01, task success, matched efficiency, or reliability rate. No shared WSLg socket or permissions are touched.
